Meet Tidbit and Sugarfoot
Tidbit
Sugarfoot
Tidbit is the quick, curious pup with the big smile. Zoom first, look second.
Sugarfoot is the steady, gentle pup with the long, soft ears and the best hugs.
For grown-upsEvery picture has a blank page behind it, so markers stay put, and a sheet of paper under the page helps too. Color a whole page or just the part you love, and look for the find-it games.
